title: underline links only no italics emphasis
name: Underline links only no italics emphasis
rule: Underline = links only; no italics for emphasis — italics are hard for dyslexia; use bold sparingly. Don’t combine underline+bold except the topic-page hyperlink style.
pass_when: Underline is only for links; emphasis is not italics; underline+bold only on the named topic-page hyperlink style.
fail_when: Underlined non-links; italics used for emphasis; underline+bold on ordinary text.
overview: Underline marks links only; emphasize with sparse bold, not italics.
apply_when: Styling Canada.ca body text, links, and inline emphasis.
not_when: The named topic-page hyperlink style that deliberately pairs underline and bold.
agent_hint: Underline links only; skip italics for emphasis; bold sparingly.
description: On Canada.ca, underline means links only. Do not use italics for emphasis — italics are hard for dyslexia — and use bold sparingly instead. Do not combine underline and bold except the named topic-page hyperlink style. Apply when styling body text, links, and inline emphasis. Fail underlined non-links, italics used for emphasis, or underline-plus-bold on ordinary text outside that topic-page style.
